name: context-bridge-mcp
description: Project-agnostic shared context layer for AI agents working across multiple repos
long_description: Context Bridge MCP gives AI agents a stateless I/O tool to read and write `.context/` folders across repos. Each repo declares its own domains via a manifest. The bridge resolves contracts across the ecosystem, tracks consumed contract versions automatically, and detects drift on the next session start. Companion skills (context-reader, context-feeder, context-bridge) install into any repo with `bridge_sync_skills`.

tools.name: bridge_manifest
tools.description: Return the full manifest — registry of all domains, components, and contracts in this repo.

tools.name: bridge_get
tools.description: Fetch a context file from the current repo's .context/ folder.

tools.name: bridge_update
tools.description: Write or overwrite a context file. Appends to the ecosystem changelog.

tools.name: bridge_list
tools.description: List all available context files. Optionally filter by domain.

tools.name: bridge_get_from
tools.description: Fetch a context file from another repo by ecosystem name or relative path.

tools.name: bridge_get_contract
tools.description: Fetch an API contract. Searches local then ecosystem repos. Pins consumed version for drift detection.

tools.name: bridge_update_contract
tools.description: Write or overwrite an API contract file. Appends to the ecosystem changelog.

tools.name: bridge_list_contracts
tools.description: List all existing contract files in this repo.

tools.name: bridge_register
tools.description: Register this repo in the shared ecosystem so other repos can discover it.

tools.name: bridge_discover
tools.description: List or inspect repos registered in the ecosystem.

tools.name: bridge_changes
tools.description: Show context/contract changes from other repos and detect contract version drift since last session.

tools.name: bridge_manifest_update
tools.description: Deep-merge a patch into the repo's manifest.json. Arrays are replaced wholesale.

tools.name: bridge_sync_skills
tools.description: Install or update the companion Claude Code skills (context-reader, context-feeder, context-bridge) into the current repo's .claude/skills/.

ecosystem_root.title: Ecosystem Root
ecosystem_root.description: Where ecosystem.json and changelog.jsonl live. Multiple repos using the bridge share this location to discover each other and detect cross-repo contract drift.
